headline: Oil Prices Slide to Multi-Week Lows Amid Middle East Peace Talks and U.S. Statements
summary: Brent and WTI crude oil prices slid about 2% to a multi-week low, reversing earlier gains as peace talks progress and following comments regarding Israel.
why: Crude oil is a globally traded commodity whose pricing is highly sensitive to geopolitical developments in the Middle East and expectations of supply disruptions.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Peace talks and political shifts lower geopolitical risk premiums embedded in crude prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Progress in peace talks and political announcements reduced fears of supply disruptions, prompting investors to sell off crude oil positions.
